title: Selection Committee's Role in Recommending Mediators

content.scenario: The National Commission needs to prepare a panel of mediators for consumer mediation. The Selection Committee, consisting of the President and a member of the Commission, recommends a list of mediators.
content.outcome: The National Commission prepares a panel of mediators based on the recommendation of the Selection Committee, ensuring that the mediators are suitable to handle consumer disputes and provide effective mediation services.

user_queries: What is the role of the Selection Committee in recommending mediators?
How are mediators selected for consumer mediation?
What is the process for preparing a panel of mediators?
